notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Cast Vulshok Battlemaster by paying {4}{R}.
When Vulshok Battlemaster enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to attach all noncreature permanents to Vulshok Battlemaster.
Cast Fumble by paying {1}{U}, returning Vulshok Battlemaster from the battlefield to your hand, and causing you to gain control of all Equipment attached to it, and attach them to another creature you control.
